comment: Advisories the production dependency audit may ignore. Each entry needs a reason and an expiry; an expired entry fails the audit again so it cannot rot. Remove an entry as soon as a fixed release exists. Do not add an advisory that has a patched version: upgrade or add a pnpm override instead.

allowed.reason: Denial of service through deeply nested brace patterns in braces <=3.0.3. No patched release exists (3.0.3 is the latest). It is reached only through tailwindcss's build-time glob handling (chokidar, fast-glob, micromatch), where the patterns are our own Tailwind content globs, never user input, and nothing at runtime expands untrusted patterns.
allowed.revisit: Check `npm view braces version`; when a fixed release ships, update the lockfile and delete this entry.
